column3: The clauses are reordered, and “the sea monster” is rendered “the dragon who lives in the sea.”
“A vineyard of delight” is rendered “A vineyard of wine,” following a different reading.
“I will march against it” is rendered “I would step on them.”
“By startling” is rendered “by banishing them,” and “he drove out” as “He has expelled them”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The fruit of the removing of his sin” is rendered “the full price of the pardoning of his sin.”
“Bring to an end its branches” is rendered “feed on its branches.”
“Beat out” is rendered “start His threshing,” and “the River” as “the Euphrates.”
